name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 22 - Am 37
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 22b. Denounces the fact that, since the start of the alleged ceasefire on 10 October 2025, Israel has killed at least 442 Palestinians and wounded another 1 235, and continues to restrict humanitarian access to the Gaza Strip; demands a real and unconditional ceasefire and the entry of necessary humanitarian aid;
